note: Hand-kept rows, not extracted. `address-map.json` is the parser's output and is rewritten whenever a page is registered again, so nothing may be edited into it; these are the rows the parser refused, read off the page by a person and written here instead. Merged with the parsed rows when the site joins them, and held to the same rule: every row cites the printed page it was read from.
why_it_exists: The parser refuses a row it cannot cut with confidence rather than cutting it approximately, which leaves a residue on every page -- rows whose size cell is blank because they continue the row above, rows whose initial value is stated conditionally in three lines, rows a two-line cell pushed off the grid. Generalising the parser until it took them would be work spent on a document that will not be revised again. So the residue is read by hand, once, and committed.
